Certares has closed a single-asset continuation fund to extend its ownership of Guardian Alarm , a Southfield, Michigan-based security and fire alarm company. Funds managed by New 2ND Capital led the new investor group. The vehicle gave Guardian’s existing shareholders the option to take liquidity and commits additional capital to the company’s acquisition program. Richard Moreau , a managing director at Certares, said the firm will keep backing Guardian through its next phase of organic growth and acquisitions. New York-based Certares invests in travel, hospitality, and business and consumer services. New 2ND, also based in New York, leads GP-led secondary deals for North American middle-market companies and is investing its fourth fund.

Guardian Alarm designs, installs and monitors security and fire alarm systems for homes and businesses. Founded in 1930, the company also handles access control and automation, runs its own around-the-clock monitoring, and provides service, maintenance and inspection for commercial and residential customers in more than 10 states across the Midwest and South. CEO Brent Uhl said the new capital will let Guardian keep investing in the business and speed up acquisitions in existing and new markets.
